main.description: A streamplace node's report of view counts for one place.stream.video over a closed time window. Published in the reporting node's server repo (not the streamer's), so a video served by multiple nodes accumulates multiple records — consumers are expected to sum across trusted reporters. The rkey is conventionally `<sha256(videoUri || windowStart)>` truncated, so re-running the aggregator over the same window is idempotent. The methodology field documents the floor used to count a session (e.g. "any-segment" = any sid that fetched ≥ threshold segment_requests).

video.description: AT-URI of the place.stream.video this count is for.

count.description: Number of distinct sessions that qualified as a view over [windowStart, windowEnd) by the stated methodology.

windowStart.description: Inclusive lower bound of the aggregation window.

windowEnd.description: Exclusive upper bound of the aggregation window.

methodology.description: Identifier for the counting algorithm. "any-segment" means: a distinct sid that fetched at least `thresholdSegments` segments for this video over the window. Future methodologies (e.g. "ms-from-metafile") will use new tags so older records remain interpretable.

thresholdSegments.description: Floor on segment_request count per (sid, video) for the "any-segment" methodology. Defaults to 1.

indexedAt.description: When the reporting node ran this aggregation. Useful for ordering successive reports.
